paragraphs: I'm applying for the internship at NYSERDA. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before the MBA I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Energy is the area I've been steering my MBA toward, and NYSERDA is where a lot of New York's clean energy planning actually gets done.

At Lenovo I owned the mapping and QA for AI-powered dashboards that saved the team 4+ hours a week on reporting, and I turned stakeholder needs into dashboards that improved campaign ROI by 20%. At JPMorgan Asset Management I built analytics frameworks to track campaign KPIs and ran peer benchmarking on marketing-channel budgets that found 30% efficiency gains.
I'd bring that mix of data work, careful checking and clear reporting to whatever the team needs this term. I'm based in New York and would welcome the chance to talk.
